question.prompt: The annual incomes of \(1{,}000\) families range from \(\$8200\) to \(\$98{,}000.\) In error, the largest income was entered on the computer as \(\$980{,}000.\) The difference between the mean of the incorrect data and the mean of the actual data is

solutions.explanation:
The mean equals the total income divided by the number of families. Since only one entry changed, the incorrect total exceeds the actual total by
\[
980{,}000-98{,}000=882{,}000
\]
dollars. Both means divide their totals by \(1{,}000\), so their difference is
\[
\frac{882{,}000}{1{,}000}=882
\]
dollars. The answer is \(\$882\), choice \(\mathrm{A}\).
solutions.title: Find the change in the total
